ria: kicking off config-only change for routing weights + batch cap. canary 4% for 12m. change window 09:00-10:00 PT.

deploy-bot: canary job c-20260425-11 started · targets=service=sidecar env=prod-canary · config: routing.weight=0.04 batch.max_tokens=1800 timeout.ms=55000

noah: are we pinning model for canary?

ria: no pin, let smart-routing choose. log model_version in traces.

noah: abort criteria noted: p95 > 320ms OR error_rate > 0.6% sustained 2m.

sre-jen: added alert rule and a dashboard section for canary shards. watching kv cache and heap.

deploy-bot: canary live at 4% started 09:07 PT. first health check due 09:19 PT.

09:15 PT toni: kv miss jumped 5% -> 9% on canary pods, p95 steady at 280ms.

ria: hold ramp. keep at 4% to let cache warm.

09:19 PT deploy-bot: canary summary p95=305ms (3m avg) error_rate=0.08% · below abort but trending.

noah: still comfortable but if p95 crosses 320ms for 2m we rollback.

09:25 PT deploy-bot: canary p95=330ms (2m) · ALERT triggered.

sre-jen: triggering rollback per plan.

deploy-bot: rollback complete. restored routing.weight=0.02 batch.max_tokens=1024 timeout.ms=45000

ria: filing follow-up to add staged kv prewarm job and gradual batch increase experiment. thanks all.
